During the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|intergalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s invasion of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="TEA" /> between [[25 ABY/Legends|25]] and [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], which was known as the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], they '''attacked''' the [[Tangrene system/Legends|Tangrene system]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Taking place at some point between 25 ABY and [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], the strike took place following an [[Attack on the Edusa system|attack]] on the [[Edusa system/Legends|Edusa system]], after which the Yuuzhan Vong traveled along a [[Axxila–Tangrene hyperlane/Legends|hyperlane]] connecting the Edusa [[Star system/Legends|system]] and the Tangrene system.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on the Tangrene system was first shown in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2009]] and written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. The Atlas included the attack in a map titled "Vector Prime and the Yuuzhan Vong advance," which showed the movements and conflicts of the various factions involved in the Yuuzhan Vong War between 25 ABY and 26 ABY. The book gives no information on the outcome of the attack, but a separate map shows the Tangrene system was under Yuuzhan Vong control by 26 ABY.<ref name="TEA" />
